subject: Webinar follow-up: Demo request and availability
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Meyers <jordan@innovatech.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Webinar follow-up: Demo request and availability

Hi Jordan 

Thanks for registering for our Wednesday webinar and for staying to the end  really glad the realtime inference segment caught your interest. I wanted to follow up and offer to schedule a short 30-minute demo so we can walk through how Redwood would fit into Innovatech's fraud-detection pipeline.

Suggested times (PDT):
- Tues 10/6 at 10:00 AM
- Tues 10/6 at 2:00 PM
- Wed 10/7 at 11:00 AM

If none of those work, feel free to grab a slot on my calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-30

I've attached the webinar slides and a short demo agenda so you can share with the team. Ava (cc'd) is our solutions engineer and would join to cover integration questions. Dylan from SDR will coordinate the calendar invite once we confirm a time.

Also, if you'd like a quick pricing heads-up or details about private deployment options, tell me and I can include billing in the call.

Talk soon,

 Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123
redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-webinar-slides.pdf, redwood-demo-agenda.docx

Subject: Re: Webinar follow-up: Demo request and availability

Hi Marissa 

Thanks  I'd love to see a demo. Tues 10/6 at 10:00 AM PDT works for me. I'll loop in our Head of Data, Emily, on the call.

A couple quick asks so we can prep:
- Can you include a short section on latency / throughput for small models vs large (we care about tail latency)?
- Any preliminary pricing tiers for a reserved-capacity setup?

If you can send a calendar invite with a Zoom link, we'll accept from there.

Cheers,
Jordan
